source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently randomized complex photo test of water channel and arcade in a Nasrid-inspired courtyard, using only visible appearance from the attached portrait. Architecture, event and wardrobe are agent choices under delegated random concept selection.
subject: Adult woman botanical illustrator with portrait-based appearance
setting: Nasrid-inspired palace courtyard with narrow water channel and surrounding arcade
event: Holding an open plant sketchbook beside the channel
visual_priorities: Water channel direction and clear water are visible
Repeated arches, columns and walkway reveal arcade depth
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photographic architectural fashion editorial in a Nasrid-inspired palace courtyard. An adult woman works as a botanical illustrator, holding an open sketchbook beside the water. Use the attached portrait as an appearance reference for her long dark wavy hair, softly oval face, brown eyes, and natural rose lips. She wears a dark teal long-sleeved silk dress and sits sideways on a low stone bench, her face turned three quarters toward the camera, the open sketchbook resting across her lap with one visible plant study and a pencil held loosely in her right hand. A narrow, shallow stone-lined water channel runs from the lower foreground toward the far courtyard, its clear water catching small reflected highlights. A continuous arcade of slender columns and repeated arches encloses the courtyard behind her; the arches open onto a shaded walkway, making its depth legible. Two low planting beds flank the channel with green leaves and a few white flowers. Late afternoon sun enters from the right, warming one edge of her hair and casting repeated arch shadows across pale paving. Compose a vertical, full-body environmental portrait with the woman left of center and the channel leading the eye into the background. Keep her face, the channel edges, and the repeated column spacing clear enough to read together. The photograph feels quietly observational, with realistic stone grain, silk folds, water reflections, and restrained color.
